people.name: Golgotha
people.line: The place where Jesus was crucified, meaning "Place of a Skull."

translations.web: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
translations.bsb: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.
translations.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
translations.asv: And when they came unto the place which is called The skull, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand and the other on the left.
